'''Marfa''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] that housed [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi]] [[Agricultural Corps/Legends|AgriCorps]] facilities during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. [[Hestizo Trace]] and the [[Murakami orchid]] she had created a [[Force-bond/Legends|bond]] with were kidnapped here by the [[Whiphid/Legends|Whiphid]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Tulkh]]. Later, [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Knight]] [[Rojo Trace]] came to the planet in search of Hestizo.<ref name="Red Harvest" />
